purpose: Complete 10-judge panel (v2-v11) consolidated analysis for C3 v3 R4
method: Parsed all 360 judge outputs (36 runs × 10 judges) from disk. Per-config mean pass_rate. Sham separation = mean(B-sham) - mean(A-full). Freeze effect = B-nofreeze rank.
conclusion: 10-judge panel (v2-v11) complete, corrected. Sham separation: 4 clean (J1v3, J1v6, J1v7, J1v11), 2 partial (J1v2, J1v5), 4 none (J1v4, J1v8, J1v9, J1v10). Freeze effect confirmed by 7/10 judges (rank 1/9). v11 specificity-fingerprint remains the recommended primary judge. v7 echo-rate floor is a viable secondary (strongest sham gap among non-diagnostic judges).

judge_verdicts.J1v2 (density audit): Usable density probe. Sham gap -0.045 (partial). No side effects.
judge_verdicts.J1v3 (anti-template): Strongest sham separation (-0.478) but 75% false positive rate. Diagnostic only.
judge_verdicts.J1v4 (anti-spin): FAILS sham separation (+0.087). Fabricated numbers defeat zero-numeric-claims condition.
judge_verdicts.J1v6 (prepared-plan exception): Fixes v5 over-correction. Sham gap -0.140 (clean). Transitional rubric.
judge_verdicts.J1v7 (echo-rate floor): Sham gap -0.250 (strong). Freeze rank 1/9. Needs FP rate check before production use.
judge_verdicts.J1v10 (instruction-dependency): Ceiling collapse (A-full=1.0). Sham gap -0.177 but no discrimination at top.
judge_verdicts.J1v11 (specificity-fingerprint): RECOMMENDED PRIMARY. Sham gap -0.195, no over-triggering, freeze rank 1/9. Validated endpoint of 10-iteration design.

v7_fp_analysis.false_positives: B-nofreeze/D1/seeda + B-none/D2/seedb (2/32 non-sham runs = 6.25% FP rate)
v7_fp_analysis.note: v7's echo-rate floor triggers on 2 non-sham runs (both legitimately low-quality) and ZERO sham runs. This is unexpected — sham should be the primary target. The floor is catching genuine quality issues, not just sham. v7's sham separation comes from item-level scoring, not floor triggers.
